mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 PM, here is today's balanced dish. It is a crisp 59 degrees at Badger Prairie County Park under clear skies. If you are looking up tonight, the International Space Station will be visible at 7:06 PM, rising over Mount Horeb in the west-southwest and tracking low across the horizon toward Belleville in the south-southwest.

October is now Community Planning Month in Verona, honoring the Planning and Development Department for their expertise in managing our city's growth. Also, keep an eye out for road construction on Highway M near the future Aldi site from October 6 through October 9, which will require detours.

We have a packed schedule starting with live music today at Bailey's Run Vineyard and Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, you can visit the Dane County Farmer's Market or catch more live music at Paddy Mac's.
On September 21, Verona Police responded to a report of retail theft after an individual was identified via surveillance video taking candy from a local retailer.
Today is the perfect day to stop by Culver's for their Flavor of the Day, Caramel Fudge Cookie Dough. The shop is currently open, so be sure to swing by before they close at 10:30 PM.
